frontmatter.name: crawl-to-llms-txt
frontmatter.description: Condense a fixed public docs site or local repo into private llms reference context: commands, config, how-tos and gotchas with source tags and verbatim code. TRIGGER: "crawl this docs site into llms.txt", "condense this repo", "pre-digest the docs", "/crawl2llms". SKIP: full repo/file/infra dossier → crawl-repo-to-llms; one document or SKILL.md → llms-txt-tooling; notes → notes-to-llms-txt; new web research → full-suite; raw mirroring → web-text-mirror; one concept → llms-concept-abstractor; structured data → firecrawl-scrape; publishable AI-search guidance → generative-engine-optimization; existing-family audit → llms-deep-optimizer. Auth- gated acquisition belongs to firecrawl-knowledge-ingest.
whenToUse: crawl this docs site and turn it into an llms.txt I can inject

make a compact reference for this library before I build against it
the knowledge is spread across README, docs/, and examples — pull it into one file
refresh the llms family for this repo, only what changed since last time
